from math import gcd

def line_cells_on_diagonal(p1, p2, diag_type='main'):
    """Get cells on line segment between p1, p2"""
    r1, c1 = p1
    r2, c2 = p2
    
    dr = r2 - r1
    dc = c2 - c1
    
    # Normalize to integer steps
    steps = gcd(abs(dr), abs(dc))
    if steps == 0:
        return [p1]
    
    norm_r = dr / steps
    norm_c = dc / steps
    
    result = [p1]
    for i in range(1, steps + 1):
        r = int(r1 + i * norm_r)
        c = int(c1 + i * norm_c)
        result.append((r, c))
    return result
